name: Coimbatore
description: Coimbatore is a mid-sized industrial and textile hub tucked against the Western Ghats, offering the lowest cost of living of India's major retirement-friendly cities. The Palghat Gap funnels a near-constant breeze through the city, tempering the tropical heat that defines most of South India and making it noticeably more comfortable than Chennai or Delhi. It's a quieter, more understated choice than Bengaluru or Goa — the expat community is small and the pace is unmistakably local — but the Nilgiri hill towns like Ooty are an easy day trip away. For FIRE seekers prioritizing value and calm over cosmopolitan buzz, Coimbatore delivers exceptional stretch for the dollar.

quickFacts.visa: India has no retirement, pension, or passive-income visa. US citizens use the e-Tourist visa — 30-day (multiple-entry) or 1-year/5-year (multiple-entry; the 5-year fee rose from $80 to $200 in 2026) — and may stay up to 180 days per visit, with total time capped at 180 days per calendar year; long-term residents get by cycling visas in and out. The only path to living in India indefinitely is the OCI card, open to people of Indian origin or those married 2+ years to an Indian citizen or OCI holder.
quickFacts.internetSpeed: 50–100 Mbps typical; solid fiber for a Tier-2 city, up to 1 Gbps
quickFacts.safetyRating: A calm, low-crime industrial city widely regarded as safe and easygoing; ordinary precautions suffice
quickFacts.climate: Tropical savanna moderated by the Palghat Gap — warm, comparatively dry, with a near-constant cooling breeze

housing.description: Modest private 1BHK, semi-furnished, on the edge of R.S. Puram / Saibaba Colony (~₹9,450)

healthcare.description: Basic individual private cover ~₹5L, fresh policy — assumes an early retiree (45–55); older retirees should budget more

transportation.description: Auto-rickshaw + occasional ride-hail (compact city, no car)

1M.lifestyle: A comfortable life at some of urban India’s lowest costs — a private 1BHK in a modest colony, home cooking with ₹120 thalis out, autos in a small city where nothing is far, and the Palghat Gap breeze keeping A/C bills genuinely low. The expat community is small and the pace is unmistakably local.

housing.description: Spacious 3BR apartment in Saibaba Colony or Race Course

dining.description: Regular dining out at Coimbatore's better restaurants and hotel dining rooms

healthcare.description: Premium insurance covering Kovai Medical Center, PSG Hospitals, and Ganga Hospital

transportation.description: Own small car or regular Uber/Ola

entertainment.description: Weekend trips to Ooty and the Nilgiris, gym membership, cultural events at local sabhas

2M.lifestyle: A spacious 3-bedroom apartment in Saibaba Colony or Race Course, dining out regularly at the city's better restaurants, and your own small car or frequent Uber. Premium health insurance covering Kovai Medical Center and Ganga Hospital. Weekend trips into the Nilgiri hills and Ooty are close and affordable. Day-to-day life is comfortable with a solid financial cushion each month. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Good furnished 1BHK / small 2BHK in Race Course or Peelamedu, gated (~₹21,700)

transportation.description: Own small car or heavy ride-hail

3M.lifestyle: Relaxed comfort in a Tier-2 city — a nice flat in the best residential belt, a small car or unlimited ride-hail, dining out several times a week, and easy weekend escapes an hour up into the Nilgiris. Solid private cover removes the main risk.

housing.description: Expansive independent villa in Race Course or Peelamedu

dining.description: Personal chef for daily meals, fine dining several times per week, catered events

healthcare.description: VIP concierge medical with dedicated physician; international hospital access

transportation.description: Luxury sedan with full-time chauffeur, domestic flights, occasional chartered travel

entertainment.description: Premium club memberships, luxury Nilgiri hill-station retreats, art collecting

domesticHelp.description: Full-time cook, housekeeper, driver, and gardener

luxuryExtras.description: Business-class international travel, luxury resort stays, property investments

5M.lifestyle: An expansive independent villa in Race Course or Peelamedu, a luxury sedan with full-time driver, and a housekeeper, cook, and gardener. Regular fine dining and business-class flights for longer trips. Premium healthcare with a dedicated physician. Coimbatore's low costs relative to this budget mean a very large monthly margin, even living at the top end of the market — enough to make regular use of Ooty as a weekend retreat. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Large apartment / independent villa in Race Course (~₹66,000)

dining.description: Frequent premium dining (Tier-2 scene is genuinely limited — capped)

healthcare.description: International/evacuation cover with regional (Bangkok/Singapore) hospital access

transportation.description: Owned car — fuel, maintenance, premium ride-hail

entertainment.description: Club membership, luxury Nilgiri resort weekends

domesticHelp.description: Cook + maid/housekeeper scaled to one home (~₹17,000)

10M.lifestyle: Luxury in a Tier-2 city means a Race Course villa, a car with driver, and a cook and housekeeper — a lifestyle costing multiples of this in Bengaluru or Delhi. The honest ceiling is set by the market: prime villa rents are a fraction of metro-prime and the fine-dining scene is thin, so there’s a real cap on spend.
